propose new values for its elements.

A change request is below. Apply it by proposing elements, as asked. Do not decide whether it is a

keep everything else as it is. A proposal replaces the whole element at its path, so read the
element first and propose it complete.

When you are done, reply with a short paragraph saying what you proposed and where.

# Domain guide: `delivery` (version 1)

_Generated from the declaration at build time. Do not edit: change the declaration._

## Purpose

An approved domain version must become working software in an environment, and nothing unverified may reach it.

**Success metric:** share of approved versions that reach verified-in-use without a manual fix or rollback (up is better)

> Approved domain versions now reach the environment as working software in one step. Nothing that fails its checks or lacks a person's approval gets there.

## People and things

**Roles:** `approver` (ana). Agents act only on a person's behalf, with a grant.

- **DeliveryRequest**: A request to deliver an approved commit of a domain, handed off by Authoring. Stages: `requested`, `previewing`, `previewed`, `deploying`, `done`, `verified` (starts `requested`).
  - facts: `domain_id` (string), `commit` (string), `interface` (string), `environment` (string), `approver` (string), `build` (string, optional), `harness_ok` (boolean, optional), `deployed` (boolean, optional), `refusal` (string, optional), `verified` (boolean, optional)
- **Environment**: Where a domain runs; it points at one deployed commit.
  - facts: `name` (string), `current_commit` (string, optional)

## Actions

🔒 only a person may take it · 📝 recorded as a decision

| action | who | on | needs first | changes | starts | event |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request_delivery` | system | creates **DeliveryRequest**; params `domain_id` (string), `commit` (string), `interface` (string), `environment` (string), `approver` (string) | — | — | — | `DeliveryRequestCreated` |
| `preview` | approver | **DeliveryRequest** | `not-deployed`: Already deployed; deliver again with a new request. | the stage (per the matrix) | kernel `preview` → `record_build` | `DeliveryRequestPreview` |
| `record_build` | the kernel | **DeliveryRequest**; params `build` (string), `harness_ok` (boolean) | — | the stage (per the matrix); `target.build` ← `params.build`, `target.harness_ok` ← `params.harness_ok` | — | `DeliveryRequestRecordBuild` |
| `deploy` 🔒 📝 | approver | **DeliveryRequest**; params `rationale` (string, optional) | `harness-passed`: Deploy only a build whose harness passed. | the stage (per the matrix) | kernel `deploy` → `record_deployment` | `DeliveryRequestDeploy` |
| `record_deployment` | the kernel | **DeliveryRequest**; params `deployed` (boolean), `error` (string) | — | the stage (per the matrix); `target.deployed` ← `params.deployed`, `target.refusal` ← `params.error` | — | `DeliveryRequestRecordDeployment` |
| `verify` 🔒 | approver | **DeliveryRequest**; params `verified` (boolean) | `deployed`: Only a deployment that happened can be verified. | the stage (per the matrix); `target.verified` ← `params.verified` | — | `DeliveryRequestVerify` |

## Transitions

For each stage: may the action happen, and where does it lead? A missing cell is undecided; nothing is ever silently allowed.

### DeliveryRequest (`stage`)

| stage | `preview` | `record_build` | `deploy` | `record_deployment` | `verify` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `requested` | → `previewing` | n/a | denied: Preview it first. | n/a | n/a |
| `previewing` | denied: A preview is running. | → `previewed` | denied: The preview has not finished. | n/a | n/a |
| `previewed` | → `previewing` | n/a | → `deploying` | n/a | n/a |
| `deploying` | denied: A deploy is running. | n/a | denied: A deploy is running. | → `done` | n/a |
| `done` | → `previewing` | n/a | → `deploying` | n/a | → `verified` |
| `verified` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | denied: Already verified. |

## Always true (invariants)

- **deployed-builds-passed-their-harness** on DeliveryRequest: Nothing reaches the environment unless its harness passed.
- **verified-requests-were-deployed** on DeliveryRequest: Only a deployment that happened is verified.
- **finished-deploys-record-the-outcome** on DeliveryRequest: A finished deploy records whether it happened.
- **deploying-builds-passed-their-harness** on DeliveryRequest: A deploy starts only from a build whose harness passed.

## Examples and scenarios

- 5 example object(s): Environment `ENV-local`, DeliveryRequest `R1`, DeliveryRequest `R2`, DeliveryRequest `R3`, DeliveryRequest `R4`
- scenario `deliver-preview-deploy-verify`: 6 step(s)
- scenario `a-failed-harness-is-never-deployed`: 1 step(s)
- scenario `a-refused-deploy-is-not-verified-and-can-be-retried`: 2 step(s)

## How to work in this domain

Generated from the actions, their actors, the matrix and the kernel calls: for each thing, how it comes to exist, then what can happen in each stage and who does it. Steps marked **a person only** are never taken by an agent.

### DeliveryRequest

- **request_delivery** by the system (a handoff from another domain) → `requested`

**In `requested`:**

- **preview** by `approver` → `previewing`. Needs: Already deployed; deliver again with a new request. Then starts kernel `preview`, answered by `record_build`. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml preview ID`

**In `previewing`:**

- **record_build** by the kernel, automatically (a reply) → `previewed`

**In `previewed`:**

- **preview** by `approver` → `previewing`. Needs: Already deployed; deliver again with a new request. Then starts kernel `preview`, answered by `record_build`. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml preview ID`
- **deploy** by `approver` — **a person only** — recorded as a decision → `deploying`. Needs: Deploy only a build whose harness passed. Then starts kernel `deploy`, answered by `record_deployment`. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml deploy ID`

**In `deploying`:**

- **record_deployment** by the kernel, automatically (a reply) → `done`

**In `done`:**

- **preview** by `approver` → `previewing`. Needs: Already deployed; deliver again with a new request. Then starts kernel `preview`, answered by `record_build`. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml preview ID`
- **deploy** by `approver` — **a person only** — recorded as a decision → `deploying`. Needs: Deploy only a build whose harness passed. Then starts kernel `deploy`, answered by `record_deployment`. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml deploy ID`
- **verify** by `approver` — **a person only** → `verified`. Needs: Only a deployment that happened can be verified. Run: `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml verify ID --verified VERIFIED`

**In `verified`:** nothing more happens (final).

## What is generated

- **Command line** `toprope-run --domain delivery.domain.yaml ...`: one subcommand per action, with the same rules as every other surface (ADR-0036), plus `get`, `history`, `allowed` and `guide`.
- **MCP server** `toprope:delivery`: one tool per action (6), plus `get_object`, `history`, `attempts`, `allowed_actions`, `describe_domain`, `world_map` and `how_to_reach`. Kernel replies (`record_build`, `record_deployment`) are tools too, but only the kernel may take them.
- **Events**: one per action (`DeliveryRequestCreated`, `DeliveryRequestDeploy`, `DeliveryRequestPreview`, `DeliveryRequestRecordBuild`, `DeliveryRequestRecordDeployment`, `DeliveryRequestVerify`); the current state is the events replayed in order.
- **World map** (`world-map.json`): every object, link, stage and (stage, action) edge.
- **Harness**: passes; decided cells covered per level: model 60/60, execution 60/60, mcp 60/60; 0 finding(s).

actions:
  request_delivery:
    description: Receive a request to deliver an approved commit, handed off by Authoring.
      The request must say which branch the commit came from.
    actor:
    - system
    creates: DeliveryRequest
    params:
      domain_id:
        type: string

        type: string
      branch:
        type: string
      interface:
        type: string
      environment:

    preconditions:

      reason: Already deployed; deliver again with a new request.
      source:
        kind: record
        ref: records:docs/harness.md#L76-L94
      status: confirmed
  record_build:
    description: Record the build and its harness result.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: DeliveryRequest
    params:

        type: string
      harness_ok:
        type: boolean
    effects:
    - set:
        target.build: params.build
        target.harness_ok: params.harness_ok
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/delivery/interview.jsonl#L4
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?

  deploy:
    description: Deploy the commit, under the fixed floor. Only a person deploys.
    actor:
    - approver
    target: DeliveryRequest

    records_decision: true
    effects:
    - call: deploy
      with:
        domain: target.domain_id
        commit: target.commit
        approver: actor.id
      reply: record_deployment
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/delivery/interview.jsonl#L4
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?

  record_deployment:
    description: Record whether the deploy happened, or which floor rule refused it.

      error:

    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/delivery/interview.jsonl#L31
    status: confirmed
  record_probes:
    description: Record what the probes found on the deployed commit.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: DeliveryRequest
    params:
      passed:
        type: boolean
      summary:
        type: string
    effects:

    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/handoffs-and-deploy.md#L76-L86
    status: confirmed
  run_probes:
    description: 'Run the probes on the deployed commit: its build, its scenarios
      where it runs, and the objects in use against every invariant.'

    - approver
    target: DeliveryRequest
    effects:

    preconditions:

content.text:
I proposed one change in the `delivery` domain. It adds an optional `replaced_commit` string fact to `objects.DeliveryRequest` (proposal E-12-486f893b). I left every other property, action, transition and invariant as it was. The draft check passes with no issues.

Nothing fills `replaced_commit` yet, so it will show as empty on every request. The request doesn't say where the value should come from. The domain has no link from a request to its Environment, and the kernel's `record_deployment` reply doesn't carry the previous commit. Filling it means one of two things:
- have the kernel report the previous commit in `record_deployment`, or
- copy `Environment.current_commit` at deploy time.

Either one is a further change, so tell me which you want.

I didn't touch the `authoring` domain.
